statement: A replacement of the destruction of cards that match ("If a "Dinomist" card(s) you control would be destroyed ..., you can destroy this card instead") replaces, once applied, the destruction of every such card destroyed at the same time, not only one of them (EffectSchema replaces, count ALL). Only words that say so make it replace one: "instead of 1 of those cards" (Blockout Curtain).

sources.name: Dinomist Stegosaur
sources.says: If 2 "Dinomist" cards you control other than it are destroyed at the same time by an opponent's card effect, its Pendulum Effect can still be applied, and then neither of the 2 is destroyed (その場合、その2枚の「ダイナミスト」と名のついたカードはどちらも破壊されません). Of the FAQs of the replacements whose English text says "card(s)" or "monster(s)", 13 say the same (Magistus Vritra, Salamangreat Balelynx, Performapal Bubblebowwow, Yosenju Shinchu L, Zefra Providence, Fury of Kairyu-Shin among them) and none says it replaces only one (read by Claude, 2026-11-21, from db-ygoresources-com/yugioh-faq-history).

sources.name: Tri-Brigade Rendezvous
sources.says: Even if several of the cards it names are destroyed by an effect, banishing this one card replaces the destruction of all of them (その複数枚が破壊される代わりにこのカード１枚を除外できます).

sources.name: Blockout Curtain
sources.says: Its "destroy this card instead of 1 of those cards" (その破壊されるカード１枚の代わりに) can be applied when 2 or more of your cards are destroyed at the same time by an opponent's effect, and replaces the destruction of one of them.

scripts: The scripts agree: the replacement's value function (repval) lets through every card of the destroyed group that matches its filter (Dinomist Stegosaur c1580833, Salamangreat Balelynx c14812471), where Blockout Curtain's (c53167658) picks one.
